sentences.en: Young people adapt themselves to something sooner than old people.
sentences.zh: 年轻人比老年人更快适应新事物。

sentences.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
sentences.zh: 人类有很强的能力去适应环境变化。

sentences.en: Why don't you adapt your way of life to circumstances?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不停下来调整生活方式以适应当前的情况？

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ad（加强）+apt（适应）→适应
